title: Bell UH-1H
notice: Start and shutdown as they worked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024 (checked live on 2026-11-26). The aircraft's checklist is not readable offline, so this is the sequence that worked, not the full checklist.
sources: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

topics.title: Start the engine
topics.summary: Battery, throttle at idle, starter, throttle full.

topics.title: Shut down
topics.summary: Throttle to idle, idle release and cut-off, rotor brake, battery.

us_ground.title: Where is the aircraft?
us_ground.text: Is the aircraft on the ground?
us_ground.help: The answer is filled in from the simulator when it can tell.

us_steps.title: Start

steps.text: Lower the collective all the way down.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)
Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)
Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Check that the governor is on (AUTO).
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Set the throttle to the idle stop.
steps.why: Without the idle release the throttle stops at idle (25 %).
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Press the starter once. It runs until about 40 % N1 and lets go by itself; the engine lights at about 10 % N1.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: When the engine is stable, open the throttle fully. The governor holds the rotor at 100 %.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

us_steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26, and the sources named in each step

us_done.title: Running
us_done.text: The engine runs with the throttle open and the rotor at 100 %.

us_air.title: Flying
us_air.text: Do not start the engine in flight.

ud_ground.title: Where is the aircraft?
ud_ground.text: Is the aircraft on the ground?
ud_ground.help: The answer is filled in from the simulator when it can tell.

ud_steps.title: Shut down

steps.text: Lower the collective all the way down.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Set the throttle to the idle stop and let the engine cool down.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: Press the idle release, then close the throttle fully: the engine stops.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

steps.text: When the rotor has slowed down, apply the rotor brake.
steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)
Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked, cold and dark; the sequence that started and stopped the engine)

ud_steps.source: Checked on the UH-1H in MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26, and the sources named in each step

ud_done.title: Shut down
ud_done.text: The engine is stopped and the rotor braked.
